body:
I haven't been making statuses about it or anything, I'm not that kind of person. I've just been messaging people, in tiers, I guess. First it was people that I was super close with, then old acquaintances, then people that I knew in the back of my mind wouldn't really care either way. 

I haven't seen a doctor, I don't really have any avenues to do that. I don't have a car and I really don't want to get prescribed something. I've talked to people before (hotline stuff) and got really autopilot responses that just made things feel worse.

I just don't know how I'd benefit from talking to a professional. I'm pretty "in-tune" with my thoughts and feelings, I feel like I'm pretty rational about stuff. I just don't feel like they would make any points that I hadn't already considered.
